visual_claim: DENBAという実店舗の機器について、利用前に仕組みを知ろうとする顧客の場面。電場や電波を可視化した光・矢印は描かず、効果を示唆しない。
composition_hint: Single photoreal medium portrait, customer face is sharp and large with center at 78–80% of generated image width; keep entire face within 71–88% width, away from the left typography veil in BOTH landscape and 4:3 crops. Face at upper-middle, looking gently down toward actual DENBA unit below; right safe area, never at extreme edge. Upper body mostly in 65–88% width. Customer carries 60–70% of visual attention. The real device and gray cabinet stay secondary below the face with plausible original placement. VERY shallow natural depth of field, portrait-lens f/1.8 look: wall, sign and surroundings softly out of focus, recognizable source anchors but absolutely not sharp/dominant. Preserve warm wall, actual logo geometry, DENBA box form and original cabinet; no invented room/mat/equipment. One photograph with natural light/contact shadows, no cutout. The later deterministic left text veil must not cross eyes, nose, mouth or meaningful action in any ratio.
